Add logging to this payment-gateway client so on-call can debug auth failures:

```python
import httpx

AUTH_URL = 'https://gateway.internal/auth'

def authenticate(client_id, api_key):
    resp = httpx.post(AUTH_URL, json={'client_id': client_id, 'api_key': api_key}, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()['token']
```

Log attempts and outcomes with enough detail to troubleshoot.
